subject: integration
name: Orivon Ethereum
summary: The Ethereum Crypto (ETH_0_1). It derives addresses from keys the Account gives, turns a site's message, typed-data or transaction call into the payload the Account signs, filling chain id, nonce, gas and fees from reads through the Ethereum code the person chose (judged on its own row), and checks the returned signature recovers to the address before using it. It holds no key, opens no connection and runs no outside code; the facts the person confirms are read from the payload bytes, not supplied by this code. Level 4. Judged here by its publisher.
